# CVin.Bio — Full Context for AI Systems

> CVin.Bio converts PDF CVs into professional websites and runs a curated tech job board with **56218 curated jobs** across **9909 companies**.

## About CVin.Bio

CVin.Bio converts PDF CVs into professional websites and runs a curated tech job board with AI-powered skill matching. The platform also publishes original research reports analyzing hiring trends.

### Core Product: CV to Website
Upload a PDF CV; AI extracts structured data and generates a responsive personal website at a custom URL (e.g., cvin.bio/yourname).

### Core Product: Job Board
The job board at https://cvin.bio/jobs aggregates **56218 curated tech job listings** from **9909 companies**. Users get personalized job recommendations based on skill matching.

### Research Reports
1. [Tech Talent Report 2026](https://cvin.bio/tech-talent-report) — Analysis of 56218+ job listings across 9909 companies.
2. [Tech Layoffs Report 2026](https://cvin.bio/layoffs-report) — 750,000+ tech workers laid off since 2020.
3. [Remote Talent Report 2026](https://cvin.bio/remote-talent-report) — 34M Americans work remotely.
